Axiom: A single change may legitimately span several scopes or modules — this is normal, especially for cross-platform work. The shape: the shared / cross-cutting part lives in the scope it belongs to (a `contracts` or shared `library` scope), and platform / consumer scopes depend on it and add only their specifics. So author the shared scope FIRST, then detail each dependent scope — the order is the Scope Graph's dependency order (a dependency is authored before its dependents). Track the bounded list of touched spec paths so the change stays coherent across a pause; it is a mode of the normal flow, not a separate branch.
